about: Every clip on the page, as the exact recording or replay that makes it. `make present-media` re-runs them, checks the hashes in clips.lock.json, and encodes. Recordings step a fixed 1/60 s per rendered frame, so frames.csv and the trace (less its viewport-dependent keys) reproduce bit for bit; pixels may differ by GPU. Each recording names the code it is made with: HEAD (this checkout) or a pinned commit, which present-media fetches and builds in a cache directory.

encode.close-call: cc_data.py: H.264 at 1280 px wide, CRF 28, keyframe every 15 frames, faststart; poster at the closest moment
encode.proof: H.264 1280x768, CRF 28, keyframe every 10 frames, faststart; poster at the figure's data-start frame
encode.tower-gap-on/off: cut from cc-towergap(-off).mp4, t = 1.7 s for 4.6 s, CRF 28; poster at 4.0 s
encode.hero: frame 199 at full size, cropped to 16:9 around the vertical centre, 1600x900
